verses.tithi: Krishna Paksha Dwadashi (until 1:46 PM EDT), then Trayodashi — Pradosh Vrat observed
verses.nakshatra: Magha (until 12:10 PM EDT), then Purva Phalguni
sankhyaConcepts: puruṣa as consciousness pervading and energizing prakṛti
Lord entering creation (āviśya) and sustaining it (dhārayāmi)
splendor of celestial bodies as reflection of divine consciousness
discernment (viveka) and devotion (bhakti) turning perception into remembrance

verses.tithi: Krishna Paksha Ekadashi (until 3:04 PM EDT), then Daśamī — Indira Ekadashi observed
verses.nakshatra: Magha (until 12:47 PM EDT), then Purva Phalguni
sankhyaConcepts: puruṣa as sustaining consciousness entering planets (āviśya)
Lord's becoming moon (somo bhūtvā) to nourish vegetation
rasātmakaḥ as essence-bearing divine vitality in food
sanātanaḥ as eternal unchanging sustaining principle
